-- a comment SELECT u.id, u.name, COUNT(o.id) AS orders FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE u.active = true AND u.created_at > DATE '2024-01-01' GROUP BY u.id, u.name HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 2 ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 10; CREATE TABLE users ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true ); SELECT CAST(x AS DOUBLE PRECISION), SUBSTRING(name FROM 1 FOR 3) FROM t WHERE x IS NOT NULL;
